title: GnssLine
description: One line of the optional gnss.jsonl in a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): a phone GNSS fix recorded at a street-facing anchor, used as a street prior. GNSS fixes are part of the contributor's trajectory, which is personal data. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: t only increases.

h_accuracy_m.description: Core Location's horizontal accuracy in metres. Fixes with a negative (invalid) accuracy are not written.
